g.text: New P2 online pilot: observed training episodes, not frozen-test curves
Completed episodes binned by 4,096 actual interactions; empty bins remain gaps. Lines are individual seeds, not confidence intervals.
A short pilot and high nominal-control success do not establish convergence or a method advantage.
